records.name: Island Health Travel Assistance
records.description: Free non-emergency travel assistance for eligible people attending Island Health appointments and facilities, including service in North Island communities.
records.population_served: People who need eligible travel assistance to Island Health appointments or facilities
records.scope_note: Transportation service; it is not a healthcare facility. Eligibility and available routes must be confirmed with Island Health.
records.eligibility: Current Island Health mobility, appointment and service-area requirements apply; the service team confirms eligibility.
records.access_pathway: Register through the official online form or call 1-844-940-6617. Island Health says a service team member will follow up to arrange eligible transportation.

eligible_trip_types: Eligible travel to Island Health appointments and facilities
transportation.delivery: Register online or call for eligibility review and trip arrangement

records.name: Port Hardy Sheltering, Sobering and Assessment Program
records.organization: The Salvation Army with Island Health and BC Housing
records.description: A Port Hardy sheltering, sobering and assessment program that provides a safer overnight setting and connection to services. It is not represented as medical withdrawal management.

records.service_area: Port Hardy and Mount Waddington area
records.scope_note: Physical program in Port Hardy; sobering and assessment are distinct from medical withdrawal-management care.
records.access_pathway: Use the official Island Health North Vancouver Island action-plan page and contact the local program to confirm current intake before travelling.

records.name: Northern Health Connections
records.description: Intercommunity transportation for eligible people travelling to non-emergency health services not available in their home community, plus specified return-home and companion travel.
records.population_served: Eligible northern B.C. patients, companions and other groups described by Northern Health Connections
records.scope_note: Regional transportation network; routes and stops must be confirmed and it does not imply a health service is physically located in the searched community.
records.eligibility: A valid BC Care Card or BC Services Card and current program eligibility rules apply; medical appointments normally require verification.
records.access_pathway: Review current routes and eligibility, then call 1-888-647-4997 to book or ask about the appropriate route.

eligible_trip_types: Non-emergency health services unavailable in the home community

transportation.delivery: Reservation and eligibility confirmation required for regular routes
